newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept oil refinery operating rate 77 pct - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept oil refinery operating rate 77 pct - MITI.

text.p: The utilisation rate of Japanese oil refineries was 77 percent in September, down from 77.8 percent in the same period last year and down from 83.1 percent in August, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI) said on Friday.
Crude throughput amounted to 19.43 million kilolitres (kl) in September, down 0.3 percent from a year earlier and down 10.4 percent from August, MITI said.
Japan's oil companies currently have a refining capacity of 5.3 million barrels-per-stream-day.
As a general rule, Japanese oil companies raise their utilisation rate towards the end of the year to build up kerosene stocks for the winter months.
